AC amendment (gap-analysis F8): Pin exact urllib Basic auth invocation to prevent encoding errors:
```python
import base64
auth = base64.b64encode(f'{JIRA_USER}:{JIRA_API_TOKEN}'.encode('utf-8')).decode('ascii')
req.add_header('Authorization', f'Basic {auth}')
```
Add a test asserting the Authorization header value is correctly base64-encoded with a fake email/token fixture (production-realistic — tests monkey-patch urlopen so real auth header is never exercised against live Jira).
